mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue growth for S&P 500 constituents and leads to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 98 signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces earnings visibility and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC drops below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% combined with a year-over-year decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% signals a synchronized labor market downturn, which reduces earnings and consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months AND PAYEMS YoY growth < -1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,100 signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 0% combined with a 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,100 signals a broad-based demand contraction, which reduces GDP growth and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 0% for 3 months AND HOUST < 1100 for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.
